detail: Ruling 16 (2026-10-07): the 128 MB bar is whole-process PEAK (VmHWM) over the workload. MEM-003's idle collection waits for 3 quiet ticks, so a burst releases nothing. E4 (EXTRACTION-PROGRAM-20261007.md ~153-163; hbox:/tank/fn/scratch/extract-core/m3/attr5.txt): fn-core peak 128.6 / 102.1 MiB, image ~200 MiB; the idle collection takes it to 9.4 MiB. Fix: a load collection decided in ACL2 (books/idle-collection.lisp fn-load-gc-verdict/-decide: collect when dynamic usage >= usage after the last collection + :load-gc-growth-mib), profile rows :load-gc-growth-mib and :load-gc-generation, called from fnn-owner-maybe-collect-idle when the idle verdict is :wait. Growth (8/16/32) and generation (2/3/6) and publication exemption to be chosen by measurement. Starting figures :load-gc-growth-mib 16 and :load-gc-generation 3 are TO BE MEASURED (N's m3 A/B), not claims.
notes: MEM-012 A/B (N, 2026-10-08, train-27 developer image 207ed2afd, m3 workload: 1,000 POSTs x 2048 octets plus 32 idle connections, 1068 MB heap, 6 arms interleaved x 2 rounds, hbox:/tank/fn/scratch/n-mem12/{arm}{k}.out). VmHWM MiB: OFF 214.0/220.5; g3m16 218.3/218.4; g2m16 211.2/222.4; g6m16 210.2/206.0; g3m8 212.8/218.4; g3m32 212.2/217.7. Filled-idle at-rest VmRSS ~154 MiB every arm (g2m16 run 2: 189.7). The collection fired 1-46 times per run (g3m8 most) and moved no arm outside the ~6 MiB run-to-run spread. Retired by the coordinator's ruling (2026-10-08): a mechanism that measurably does nothing is a twin. The peak points at MEM-013 (the checkpoint history image plus its resize copies, lane n-mem13).
title: during a POST burst nothing releases pages: fn-core peak 128.6 MiB, image ~200 MiB, about 38 MiB of it garbage promoted into generations 0-3
